display_information.name: Status for Slack
display_information.description: Set your Slack status from your Apple Watch
display_information.long_description:
Status for Slack puts your Slack status on your Apple Watch.

Tap a preset like Lunch, In a meeting, or Focusing, and your status is set before your arm is back down. A haptic confirms it, and a checkmark shows which status is active.

• Presets for your day: start with Lunch, In a meeting, Focusing, Away, and Out of office, or make your own on your iPhone with any Slack emoji.
• Clears itself: each preset can expire after 15 minutes to 4 hours, or at a time of day.
• Ask Siri: say "Set Status to Lunch" or "Clear Status", or use the actions in Shortcuts.
• Private by design: the app only asks to read and set your own status. Your sign-in stays in the Keychain on your iPhone and Apple Watch. No accounts, no analytics, no tracking.

Get it on the App Store: https://www.statusforslack.app
Support: support@laurabeatris.com

Status for Slack is an independent app and is not made by or affiliated with Slack Technologies.
